text: let me atleast have five free icons or else.......
author: Rozika Ladvenicza
developer_reply:
Hey Rozika, we do understand your concern but while other apps restrict core functionality like the number of habits we decided that personalization would be one of our paid features. However we would like to understand what icons would you have used, maybe we will make a free set for some of them!

Paul, co-creator of Habit It
